criteria.statement: `graph-run/SKILL.md` documents `/graph-run "<request>" [paths...]` and markdown pasted in the same message as accepted intake.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` names `.worktrees/.graph-intake/<run-id>/` as the staging path, written before node 1.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states why staging sits outside the working tree, citing node 1's stash/auto-commit sweep and the swept untracked source file.
`thejudge-kickoff/SKILL.md` states the copy into `PRD/work/<slug>/intake/`, the commit, and the staged-copy deletion, after the package folder exists.
The contract's `## Ledger` section states the staging path is recorded at node 2's first ledger write, with the reason.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` states an unreadable or missing supplied path is reported before node 1 and the run does not start on partial material.
The contract states intake is copied and never referenced in place, and that no size gate is applied.
`git status --porcelain docs/whatIsGraph/` still shows the folder untracked; nothing in it is staged or committed by this slice.
`npm run skills:ai-sync` run and `diff -rq .claude/skills .agents/skills` prints nothing.
Dry-run the staging path: create `.worktrees/.graph-intake/<test id>/`, drop a file, confirm `git status --porcelain` omits it, remove it. Record the output.
